Why 3rd and fifth option not correct??

posts.name: Rishit Pant
posts.cooked:
3rd option will look for occurrence of characters 3 times consecutively. Example: ‘zzz’ : will match
but ‘abcaa’ : this wont match as ‘bc’ is in between. so we use .* for it.

5th option I think says that the string should start and end with the same character, so it will not match every string.

posts.cooked: in the 3rd option (.) group is consecutively repaeting thrice as \1 is the backreference of (.)
